MATCH (root:Document {tenant_id: $tenant_id, path: $doc_selector, latest: true}) OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[:IS_COMPOSED_OF*1..]->(leaf:Document {tenant_id: $tenant_id, latest: true}) WHERE NOT (leaf)-[:IS_COMPOSED_OF]->(:Document) WITH root, collect(DISTINCT leaf) AS leaves RETURN CASE WHEN size(leaves) > 0 THEN [l IN leaves | {name: l.name, path: l.path}] ELSE [{name: root.name, path: root.path}] END AS docs ORDER BY root.path
